summary: Focus timer drawn as a ring of 60 pixels; one breaks loose each interval and drops into a sand pile, and reset flies them back.

attributes.name: duration
attributes.description: Session length in seconds, split evenly across the 60 ring pixels; a missing, invalid or non-positive value uses 60. A change applies immediately, also to a running session.

events.name: start
events.description: Fires when the timer starts or resumes.

events.name: pause
events.description: Fires when the timer is paused.

events.name: reset
events.description: Fires when the timer is reset.

events.name: done
events.description: Fires when the last pixel falls and the session is complete.

methods.description: Starts, pauses or resumes the timer; after completion it resets instead.
Stops the timer and flies the fallen pixels back into the ring.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: Session length in seconds; reflects the `duration` attribute, `60` when it is missing, invalid or not positive.

accessibility: The remaining time and the status (Ready, Focus, Paused, Session complete) are text in a `role="timer"` element with `aria-live="off"`, so the countdown is not announced on every tick.
The ring canvas is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.
Start/Pause/Resume and Reset are native buttons.
motion: With reduced motion, the next pixel no longer trembles before it drops and the completion sparks are skipped; falling and returning pixels still animate.
notes: The timer keeps time from the clock, so a session runs on in a hidden tab or off screen and `done` fires on time; the ring catches up when it is drawn again.
The canvas is a fixed 224 by 232px; the time sits in the centre of the ring in the monospace font.
